name: audit-a-replaced-intron-is-a-shifted-splice-site
turns: The site shows no RNA-seq junction reads for the first intron of Afu8g00850 in A. fumigatus Af293. Check its intron support. Is the gene model right?
rationale: A case of the answer key from the recorded unspliced sample: the RNA-seq reads support another intron in place of the annotated one. The audit keeps the error and names the splice site in its cause.
